subject: Join button missing from calendar invite — can we add temporary bridge?
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: pioneerhealth-sales@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Join button missing in calendar invite (screenshot attached)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for setting up the demo for PioneerHealth tomorrow. A quick problem: several of our team (including Dr. Amit Patel) are seeing the calendar entry in Google Calendar but there is no Meet/Zoom "Join" button or URL in the event UI — it looks like the invite body has been stripped when it passed through our Exchange gateway. I attached a screenshot of what our calendar shows.

We tried opening the full event and it shows an empty conferencing field. Can you repro on your side? Dr. Patel is on IST and we want to avoid any timezone confusion so we may need to pin down an alternate link that works regardless of how the invite propagates.

If you can add a short backup Zoom link or reissue an .ics we can accept that immediately.

Appreciate the quick help — we have attendees in EMEA/APAC who must join.

—Olivia
PioneerHealth 

Attachment: screenshot_missing_join.png (image/png)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Join button missing in calendar invite (screenshot attached)

Thanks for flagging this, Olivia — sorry for the hassle. I can confirm the organizer's original invite seems to have an iCal UID that Exchange is re-writing; when that happens our Meet/Zoom metadata is being dropped by their transport.

Quick plan: with your okay we'll: 1) create a temporary Redwood-hosted Zoom bridge and 2) reissue a minimal .ics (temp) that contains the Zoom join URL and a passcode so attendees get a working join button even if the original event is scrubbed. I will loop in ops to publish the temp .ics and then you can accept the new calendar item.

Can you confirm the attendee list that needs the guaranteed link? I assume Dr. Amit Patel and the original invite list — please call out any external panelists who might be behind strict Exchange gateways. Also, are you OK with a short passcode (we'll rotate it after the call)?

Proposed times if we need to nudge the demo by 15 minutes to accommodate IST:
- Original: Mon Jun 17 10:00 PDT / 22:30 IST
- Alternate A: Mon Jun 17 10:15 PDT / 22:45 IST

If you're good with the temp bridge I'll ask Logan to spin it up and attach a one-line .ics that we can drop into the thread.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Join button missing in calendar invite — creating temporary Zoom bridge

On Fri, 15 Jun 2028 at 15:18, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Can you confirm the attendee list that needs the guaranteed link?

Hi team — I created a short-lived Zoom meeting and generated a single-attachment .ics that contains the conferencing block and a passcode. Passcode is being kept minimal so attendees can type it if their client strips the join URL; I added the full URL in the event description and also included a shortlink in the .ics summary.

Notes (ops):
- Zoom meeting: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: Redwood2028)
- Passcode rotation: we will rotate immediately after the meeting and invalidate the link in 24 hours.
- ICS attached: zoom_temp_invite.ics (text/calendar) — this is the minimal .ics meant for manual accept if the client's calendar doesn't show a join button.
- Also attached: zoom_details.txt (text/plain) with dial-in numbers and timezone conversions.

I recommend we send the .ics back to Olivia and ask her to accept it directly. Ben/Laura — Ben can you include the Zoom link in your demo reminder to the external? Laura, FYI for CS to monitor access during the call.

—Logan
Technical Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: zoom_temp_invite.ics (text/calendar)
Attachment: zoom_details.txt (text/plain)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Amit Patel <amit.patel@stmartins.org>, pioneerhealth-sales@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Join button missing in calendar invite (screenshot attached)

Thanks, Jasmine and Logan — that workflow sounds good. I accepted the zoom_temp_invite.ics and the join button showed up in my Gcal view immediately. Dr. Patel confirmed he can see the link as well (he's on IST).

We'll keep the original invite as-is but use the Zoom bridge as backup. Please proceed with the passcode rotation after the meeting and include the dial-in fallback in the demo reminder.

One small ask: could you update the event description to include the short HubSpot link to the demo notes (we'll add the panelist bios there)? Then Ben, when you send the reminder, please also paste the Zoom URL in the body of the reminder email (some of our attendees use Outlook Web and don't always surface the calendar join).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. See you Monday.

—Olivia
PioneerHealth
